question: Five people P, Q, R, S and T are seated in a straight row, all facing the north. Exactly three people are seated to the right of S. P and Q are not occupying any end seats. T is seated third to the left of Q. Where is R sitting?

options.text: Second to the left of S
Second to the left of T

solution:
**Given :** Five people P, Q, R, S and T are seated in a straight row, all facing the north.

**Explanation : **

1) Exactly three people are seated to the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83166b25ddfcc5d1d193258503cf1c8fb27c0b9b948813228d607177f4a55fac.png] 

2) P and Q
